title: Cassava Cake
hookLine: Global-inspired cassava cake with 6 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Prep & Mix: Cassava Cake
steps.instructionTemplate: Bring coconut milk to a boil. Add sugar, stirring until completely dissolved and continue to boil for about 45 minutes. Stir gently over low to medium-low heat until completely dissolved and glossy, scraping the sides so nothing crystallizes or scorches. Incorporate {m53508_1}, {m53508_2}, {m53508_3}, and {m53508_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure cassava first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Build Flavor: Cassava Cake
steps.instructionTemplate: Reserve ½ cup of the coconut milk/sugar mixture for later. Combine remaining ingredients in a large mixing bowl, stir until well blended. Incorporate {m53508_5} and {m53508_6} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Shape & Layer: Cassava Cake
steps.instructionTemplate: Add hot coconut milk mixture and stir well. Mixture should be of a thick liquid texture. Mix gently until just combined with no dry streaks remaining, then bake until the edges are golden and a toothpick comes out with moist crumbs.

steps.title: Bake / Chill: Cassava Cake
steps.instructionTemplate: Use 1 tablespoons of coconut milk mixture to grease baking pan. Pour batter into prepared baking pan and bake at 350°F (basting occasionally with reserved coconut milk mixture) for 2 to 3 hours or until knife inserted in centre comes out clean.

steps.title: Viral Finish: Cassava Cake
steps.instructionTemplate: Spread any remaining coconut milk mixture over top of cake. Place cake on top of stove to cool completely. Let Cassava Cake cool for 10–15 minutes so the crumb sets cleanly before slicing into 6 portions, then garnish and serve.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Wait until the sponge feels cool to the touch before frosting so your glaze or cream stays thick and glossy.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 45 mins!
